scenario.note: The objective maximizes sugar beet grown while maintaining zero loss in total five-year profit, preserving the original profit level.

The five-year profit is fully intact, so the yearly profit is constrained to zero in each year to preserve the total profit. The objective is maximized under this constraint to achieve the largest possible total sugar beet grown.
The first stage maximizes total profit as in the original model. The second stage maximizes total sugar beet sold across all years, subject to the first stage's optimum.
The first objective maximises total profit (original objective), then the second maximises total sugar beet sold across all years, subject to the first objective being unchanged at its optimal value.
The planner's priorities are ordered: first maximize total profit, then minimize total grain grown, then maximize total heifer calves raised. This is a lexicographic objective with three stages.
